author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. 'The one line a read tool prints. Says what, and what to do' still holds across every branch: unreachable-sha, clean-but-dirty, and the general case each return a single string ending in '- run memway index'. The hash moved because 0.55.5 changed what feeds it - lag() now counts from baseline_for_tree, so the 'N commits ahead' number is measured from the commit whose content the map actually is - but this function's own contract, one actionable line, is untouched.
